summary: Implemented dispatcher support for Claude pty-attach agentRef persistence, exact UUID resume migration, fail-closed invalid resume, stop/delete, and watch routing.

REQ-005-B05: Dispatcher now recognizes Claude pty-attach refs by claudeSessionId/runtimeId without regressing OpenCode opencodeSessionId refs.
Prompt completion persists full Claude pty-attach agentRef when driver mutates runtimeId, claudeSessionId, processGeneration, terminal, or conversationReady.
Incoming messages for legacy Claude refs migrate only when claudeSessionId is an exact UUID, via driver.resumeSession; invalid or missing UUID fails closed before prompt.
/attach claude <uuid> resumes exact Claude UUID via driver.resumeSession and stores returned pty-attach ref; no --continue or latest-session guessing is used.
stop/delete/watch paths pass the current Claude pty-attach agentRef to the driver and reuse existing Feishu watch event dispatch.

validation.summary: ESLint completed with exit code 0 and no output.

observed_failures: New REQ-005-B05 tests initially failed because dispatcher lacked /attach claude <uuid> exact resume handling and complete pty-attach ref persistence semantics.

known_risks: T5 adds dispatcher-level /attach claude <uuid>; UI/help discoverability and any richer T6 admin/API exposure remain downstream work.
ClaudeDriver watchSession currently determines actual transcript watching behavior; dispatcher only guarantees handler routing for AgentEvent TEXT/DONE emitted by the driver.
